notes:
An official legal procedure conducted when the cause of death is unclear. In Japan, {検視|けんし} is performed by a prosecutor or police officer (not a medical doctor) to determine whether foul play is involved. If further medical examination is needed, it leads to ⟦{司法|しほう}{解剖|かいぼう}→司法解剖：25185_shihoukaibou⟧ (judicial autopsy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検視|けんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct an inquest
- {検視|けんし}{官|かん}: coroner, medical examiner
- {検視|けんし}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: inquest report
- {検視|けんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: results of the inquest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{検死|けんし}→検死：19209_kenshi⟧: postmortem examination — variant writing, often used interchangeably but technically less formal
- ⟦{司法|しほう}{解剖|かいぼう}→司法解剖：25185_shihoukaibou⟧: judicial autopsy — a more thorough medical procedure ordered when foul play is suspected
- ⟦{解剖|かいぼう}→解剖：14191_kaibou⟧: autopsy, dissection — the medical procedure itself

definitions.explanation: an official examination of a dead body to determine the cause and circumstances of death, conducted by legal authorities

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{検視|けんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The police conducted a coroner's inquest.
